event.title: The FSFE discusses Copyrightability of LLM-generated code at the NGI0 Webinars (online)

body.p: On Thursday, 29 October 2026, at 13:00 CET, our Legal Programme Manager Gabriel Ku Wei Bin will give an online legal education webinar on the copyrightability of code generated using Large Language Models (LLMs). The session will explore legal questions arising from the use of LLMs in Free Software development, particularly concerning copyright and licensing. The session is part of the NGI0 Webinars organised by the NLnet Foundation.
The webinar is open to everyone and no registration is required. Participants can join directly via BigBlueButton at vc.ngi-0.eu/rooms/ahq-y96-uhs-jka.
